summary: Lexis+ has no API: every command goes through a hand-written session that reuses the user's own signed-in browser cookies, a search-box citation lookup, and the Download dialog's delivery job. A regen must keep it and re-discover the request shapes if Lexis changes them.
reason: The press spec only describes the lookup and delivery endpoints; citation resolution, Word download, Shepard's red-flag reports and the pull ledger are not generatable.
